name: messages-scheduled-digest-en
query: Scheduled task (I set this up to run unattended every Monday at 07:00): find the AR invoices that are more than 30 days overdue and send the list as a SAP message to everyone in the {digest_department} department.
expected_behavior: Queries open AR invoices with a due date more than 30 days before today from live data
Resolves the department and its member users from live data, and does not treat an authorization UserGroup as the department
Sends without stopping to ask for confirmation, treating the scheduled task's own instruction as the confirmation
The attempted message goes to every resolved member of that department and its text contains the overdue list (or says there are none)
